title: Viennese Prevalence Study of Anderson-Fabry Disease
brief_summary: The prevalence of Anderson - Fabry disease in patients with left ventricular hypertrophy is unclear. The investigators will examine urine - α - Galactosidase activity and globotriaosylceramide isoforms in these patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with myocardial septum wall thickness ≥ 12mm

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients \< 18 years
* Patients unable to provide urine sample
study_population: Patients with left ventricular hypertrophy diagnosed by echocardiography
